filter_note.note: Friday of Week 8, final injury reports out. Loudest by count: GB, CAR, CHI, BUF, DAL, NE, KC, TEN, NO, CLE. Dropped mostly cross-club leftovers (Drew Brees tier list, analytics trade-proposal graphic, NFC North standings recap, Madden Most Feared cards), college football (Arizona State helmet, Georgia-Florida, UCF Space Game, Texas Tech, Arch Manning, Halloween uniforms, G6 playoff), other sports (Diamondbacks, Florida Panthers NHL, Pelicans, Heat, Pacers, F1 Mexico, Houston Comets, Belfast Giants, Bodo/Glimt), gags and celebrity (Verse Key & Peele clip, Watson Titans hecklers, Fidone tattoos, Colts superfan anthem, Goo Goo Dolls halftime, Budda Baker costume kept only for trade news), nostalgia (Herm Edwards rant, Eric Metcalf 1993, Travis Hunter 2024), owner side business (Gayle Benson hotel buy), and items last updated before the 24h window (Jonah Laulu waiver claim, Saquon Giants comments, Bears odds post). HOU, JAX, LAR, NO had no club-room story in the pool.
